records.agenda_text: A variance to reduce the required side-yard setback from 10' to 5' on the west side of 1407 Charles Street.
records.request: Make a recommendation on, and set a public hearing for the Board of Adjustment on September 8th, 2026, to hear and consider a variance to the side-yard setback for 1407 Charles Street, reducing it from 10' to 5'.
records.recommendation: Staff do not recommend approval of the variance as presented finding that it does not meet the evaluation criteria outlined in § 156.081 D. The Commission may consider a reduction of the side-yard setback on the west property line from 10' to 8' to align with the existing zoning code, providing the minimum necessary relief for the use of the property.
records.legal_description: Lot 2 of Block 2 of the Ruby Ridge Addition to the City of Spearfish

records.title: Variance — 1407 Charles Street
records.agenda_text: A variance to reduce the required side-yard setback from 10' to 5' on the west side of 1407 Charles Street, and set a public hearing for the Board of Adjustment for September 8th, 2026.
records.request: Make a recommendation on, and set a public hearing for the Board of Adjustment on September 8th, 2026, to hear and consider a variance to the side-yard setback for 1407 Charles Street, reducing it from 10' to 5'.
records.recommendation: Staff recommends denial of the variance as presented from 10 feet to 5 feet, based on the finding that it does not meet the evaluation criteria outlined in § 156.081 D. Staff supports the variance from 10' to 8' to align the plat note with the existing zoning code, providing the minimum necessary relief for the use of the property. Staff recommend setting the public hearing for the Board of Adjustment for September 8th.
